slides.title: HIPFIRE WORKS
rules: MW4 has no hipfire bloom: bullets go where your crosshair points.
In close fights you can skip aiming down sights.

slides.title: SHOOT THE SMOKE
rules: Gunfire and explosions break up Smoke Grenade + Smoke Wall cover.
The gaps open short sightlines through the smoke.

slides.title: TRIP WIRE TRAPS
rules: Several Trip Wires link into one network of explosives.
Set them where enemies will walk, not where they stand.

slides.title: SPAM YOUR UTILITY
rules: Every Field Upgrade recharges: use it more than once per match.
Since Nov 16: 75 % less impact damage at range. Use it close.

slides.title: LITHIUM DOORS
rules: Press the button next to a garage door to close it halfway.
Slide under it to surprise players on the other side.

slides.title: KILL BLOCK
rules: Use the letter + number grid on the outer walls.
Layout and shared loadout change every 2 rounds.
Time runs out? Grab the Overtime Flag.
